name: Find and replace
description: Find in the file you're on (⌘F), and replace (⌥⌘F): match case, whole words or a regular expression, with how many matches there are. Live preview and reading find what's shown (in a table, a callout, folded details; not a link's address), source mode everything. In reading view it only finds. On a page that isn't a text file (a dashboard, Today), ⌘F finds in what it shows.
